lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 9 distinct, high-contrast vertical lines are visible on the torso. Spacing is relatively uniform across the midsection, with slightly tighter intervals observed at the anterior and posterior terminals of the torso mass.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first and second anterior lines are abbreviated, terminating before reaching the dorsal midline. The two most posterior lines are fragmented and terminate significantly above the ventral boundary.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 8-10 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower haunch and upper hind limb, concentrated below the terminal vertical lines.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Four spots align in a horizontal geometric row across the mid-thigh, positioned superior to the hock.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a visible white chevron marking across the bridge of the muzzle and distinct white patches on the lower legs above the hooves.
